description: A University of Virginia Biocomplexity release supplies coarse synthetic people, households and activity locations for Iceland. Zenodo labels the archive and separate contact-matrix CSV open under CC BY 4.0. The public README documents person, household, residence, activity-site and assignment CSVs inside the ZIP, with validation plots outside it. It lists GPW demographic counts, World Bank activity templates and OpenStreetMap-derived places. A modeller could use the population to test regional service access or emergency-response demand after adding Icelandic roads, hazards and facilities. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Iceland dataset. A limitation is that the README does not name a source for household-size distributions even though it describes household records; this provenance needs checking before demographic calibration. Generated activity places are not evidence of real travel, and the ZIP was not downloaded to assess rows, coordinates or assignment consistency.
